tier1.benefitFactor.label: Tier 1 benefit factor
tier1.benefitFactor.unit: fraction of average final salary per year of service
tier1.benefitFactor.citation: Calculating Your Retirement Benefit, Tier 1, p.24

tier1.afsYears.label: Tier 1 average final salary: highest years averaged
tier1.afsYears.unit: fiscal years (Oct-Sep), highest of the last 10
tier1.afsYears.citation: Calculating Your Retirement Benefit, Tier 1, p.24

tier1.serviceAnyAge.label: Tier 1 service retirement at any age
tier1.serviceAnyAge.citation: Service Retirement, p.18, Tier 1 (30 years where the employer never adopted 25-year retirement; Huntsville has, per user)

tier1.ageWithTen.label: Tier 1 service retirement age with 10 years

tier1.contributionFLC.label: Tier 1 (and converted Tier 2) firefighter contribution rate
tier1.contributionFLC.citation: Act 2022-348 page: Tier II members pay 8.5% for firefighters

tier2.benefitFactor.label: Tier 2 benefit factor
tier2.benefitFactor.unit: fraction of average final salary per year of service
tier2.benefitFactor.citation: Calculating Your Retirement Benefit, Tier 2, p.25

tier2.afsYears.label: Tier 2 average final salary: highest years averaged
tier2.afsYears.unit: fiscal years (Oct-Sep), highest of the last 10
tier2.afsYears.citation: Calculating Your Retirement Benefit, Tier 2, p.25

tier2.benefitCap.label: Tier 2 benefit cap
tier2.benefitCap.citation: Calculating Your Retirement Benefit, Tier 2, p.25

tier2.ageFLC.label: Tier 2 firefighter service retirement age with 10 years
tier2.ageFLC.citation: Service Retirement, p.18, Tier 2 (age 56 for FLC)

tier2.serviceReduced.label: Tier 2 retirement with 30 years before age 56 (firefighters)
tier2.serviceReduced.unit: 30 years of service, benefit reduced 2% for each year under age 56

stress.yearsPerBonusYear.label: Stress bill (hazardous duty) credit: years of firefighter service per bonus year
stress.yearsPerBonusYear.citation: Hazardous Duty, p.12; Firefighters ... (Tier 1 Only), p.23. Applies to converted Tier 2 per user.

stress.excludesSickLeave.label: Stress credit is figured on service excluding converted sick leave
stress.excludesSickLeave.citation: User was told sick leave does not count toward the stress bill

stress.countsForEligibility.label: Stress credit counts toward retirement eligibility
stress.countsForEligibility.citation: Hazardous Duty, p.12: may not be used to meet creditable service requirements

stress.countsForInServiceDeath.label: Stress credit counts toward eligibility for an in-service death
stress.countsForInServiceDeath.citation: Death of a Member Prior to Retirement, p.16

sickLeave.daysPerMonth.label: Sick leave conversion chart: days per month of credit
sickLeave.daysPerMonth.unit: days (0-10 days = 0 months, 11-30 = 1 month, then 20 days per month)
sickLeave.daysPerMonth.citation: Sick Leave Conversion Tier 1 Only, chart p.22

sickLeave.chartMaxMonths.label: Sick leave conversion chart maximum
sickLeave.chartMaxMonths.unit: months (711-730 days); the employer sets the actual cap
sickLeave.chartMaxMonths.citation: Sick Leave Conversion Tier 1 Only, chart p.22

sickLeave.countsForEligibility.label: Converted sick leave counts toward retirement eligibility
sickLeave.countsForEligibility.citation: Sick Leave Conversion Tier 1 Only, p.21

plop.maxMonths.label: PLOP maximum
plop.maxMonths.unit: months of the Maximum benefit, $1,000 increments
plop.maxMonths.citation: Partial Lump Sum Option Plan, pp.27-28

plop.reductionPer1000.label: PLOP monthly reduction per $1,000 by age at retirement (Maximum option)
plop.reductionPer1000.unit: $ per month per $1,000 of lump sum

death.preEligibility.label: Death before retirement eligibility (1+ year of service)
death.preEligibility.value: contributions + interest + prior fiscal year salary

death.eligibleOption.label: Death after retirement eligibility: surviving spouse may choose Option 2 lifetime benefit
death.eligibleOption.citation: Preretirement Death Benefit, Eligible to Retire, p.16

contributions.interestRate.label: Interest credited on member contributions
contributions.interestRate.citation: Refund of contributions: four percent per annum (2019 Tier 2 handbook); used as an estimate for Tier 1

reemployment.earningsLimit.label: Retiree earnings limit with an RSA participating employer
reemployment.earningsLimit.unit: $ per calendar year (2019 figure, CPI-indexed; check the RSA website for the current year)

cola.retiree.label: Retiree COLA
cola.retiree.unit: per year; ad hoc only, needs the Legislature and the city council
cola.retiree.citation: Cost-of-Living Adjustments; not part of the plan
